# Material Color Utilities — HCT subset

Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.

Source: https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities
Pinned revision: bd811e4ca2ab94c4ce3cadc89c19b1820b9704b3

The HCT, CAM16, viewing conditions, color and math utilities are bundled into
assets/js/ui.js. Upstream source files and copyright notices are retained in
vendor/material-color-utilities. TypeScript syntax and module imports/exports
are transformed by scripts/bundle-material-colors.mjs using Node's built-in
TypeScript transformer. No npm dependency or browser-side import is required.

Keep this README, LICENSE and the embedded copyright notices when redistributing.
